topic: 现在完成时及其核心标志词 (Present Perfect Tense & Signal Words)
teaching_notes: 亲爱的小朋友们，现在完成时（have/has + 动词过去分词）就像是一座连接“过去”与“现在”的彩虹桥！它用来表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响，或者从过去一直持续到现在的状态。句子里常藏着提示你的“小精灵”标志词：表示“已经”用 already（多用于肯定句），表示“刚刚”用 just，表示“还未/是否”用 yet（多用于否定句和疑问句句末）；表示持续时间段用 for（如 for 3 years），而表示时间起点则用 since（如 since 2020 或 since I was 8）。

questions.question: Ms. Green _____ English in our school since 2018.
questions.explanation: 句中有“since + 时间点 (2018)”，表示从过去持续到现在的动作，主语 Ms. Green 是第三人称单数，故用现在完成时 has taught。

questions.question: Have you _____ visited the National History Museum in London?
questions.explanation: 在现在完成时的疑问句中，表示“曾经”常用 ever，放在主语和过去分词之间。

questions.question: I am sorry, but I haven't finished reading this adventure book _____.
questions.explanation: yet 经常用于现在完成时的否定句或疑问句句末，表示“还（未）”。

questions.question: Ben and Luke have been best friends _____ three years.
questions.explanation: three years 是一段时间（时间段），与现在完成时连用时前面需要加介词 for。

questions.question: Look! The kitchen floor is bright and clean because Mum has _____ swept it.
questions.explanation: 根据 Look! 和干净的地面可知，妈妈“刚刚”扫过地，表示刚刚发生的动作对现在产生的影响用 just。

questions.question: We don't need to order food because Dad has _____ cooked dinner for us.
questions.explanation: already 常用于肯定句中间，表示“已经”做好了某事。

questions.question: Tom is very excited because he has _____ seen real snow before; this is his first time!
questions.explanation: 根据“这是他第一次看到雪”可知，他以前“从未”见过雪，表示否定含义的“从未”用 never。

questions.question: How long _____ you _____ your pet dog, Buddy?
questions.explanation: How long（多久）提问动作持续的长度，需搭配现在完成时。主语是 you，助动词用 have，have 的过去分词是 had。

questions.question: Lily hasn't washed her tennis shoes _____, so she cannot wear them today.
questions.explanation: 在否定句句末表示“还未”刷鞋，应填 yet。

questions.question: Mr. Harrison has lived in Beijing _____ he was twenty years old.
questions.explanation: “he was twenty years old”是一个明确的时间起点（一般过去时从句），前面需要使用 since。

questions.question: _____ you ever _____ a camel in the desert?
questions.explanation: 询问过去是否有某种经历用“Have + 主语 + ever + 过去分词”，ride 的过去分词是 ridden。

questions.question: Watch out! A yellow school bus has _____ stopped right in front of the gate.
questions.explanation: Watch out!（当心！）提示动作刚刚发生，强调对现在的影响，用 just（刚刚）。

questions.question: They have stayed at this seaside hotel _____ last Sunday.
questions.explanation: last Sunday 是时间起点，搭配现在完成时要用介词 since。

questions.question: I have _____ packed my school bag, so I can go out and play now.
questions.explanation: 句意为“我已经整理好了书包”，肯定句中表达“已经”用 already。

questions.question: My sister has kept this lovely doll _____ five months.
questions.explanation: five months 是“时间段”，前面搭配介词 for。

questions.question: "Has Jack _____ eaten Japanese sushi before?" "No, this is his first time."
questions.explanation: 疑问句中询问“曾经”是否吃过，应该填 ever。

questions.question: We haven't met our new science teacher _____.
questions.explanation: 否定句句末表达“还未见到”，使用 yet。

questions.question: The students have played basketball on the playground _____ two hours.
questions.explanation: two hours（两小时）表示时间段，与完成时连用需使用介词 for。

questions.question: She has _____ tried durian fruit because she really hates its smell.
questions.explanation: 根据后文“讨厌它的气味”可知，她“从未”尝过榴莲，故选 never。

questions.question: How long _____ your elder brother _____ a member of the school orchestra?
questions.explanation: How long 引导的疑问句，主语是 your elder brother（单数），用助动词 has + 过去分词 been。

questions.question: I haven't heard from my pen pal in Australia _____ last month.
questions.explanation: last month 是明确的时间点，表示“自上个月以来”，介词选 since。

questions.question: The plane has _____ landed at the airport safely; all passengers are getting off.
questions.explanation: 表示飞机“刚刚”安全降落，用 just 放在助动词 has 和过去分词 landed 之间。

questions.question: Have you _____ your math test papers yet?
questions.explanation: Have 引导的现在完成时结构中，动词必须用过去分词形式 checked。

questions.question: They haven't bought the birthday cake for the party _____.
questions.explanation: 否定句句末用 yet 表示“还没有买”。

questions.question: My grandfather has collected vintage stamps _____ 1995.
questions.explanation: 1995 是具体年份（时间起点），配合现在完成时要用 since。

questions.question: He has _____ left the classroom; you can still catch him in the hallway!
questions.explanation: 根据“你在走廊还能追上他”可知，他是“刚刚”离开教室，填 just。

questions.question: Anna has lived in Shanghai with her family _____ a very long time.
questions.explanation: a very long time（很长一段时间）是时间段，前面用介词 for。

questions.question: _____ you finished reading that thick Harry Potter book yet?
questions.explanation: 句尾有标志词 yet，且动词是过去分词 finished，疑问句句首需填助动词 Have。

questions.question: I have _____ traveled to North America, but I hope to visit Canada next year.
questions.explanation: 根据后半句“希望明年能去”可知，我“从未”去过北美，选 never。

questions.question: Uncle Sam has owned his blue bicycle _____ he was ten years old.
questions.explanation: “he was ten years old”是过去的时间起点从句，前面连接现在完成时主句需用 since。
